notablePrerequisites:
Brion does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, dealing damage equal to Soul of Eternity's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
